title: Turning down sideman offers to stay with his men
summary: Cab Calloway offered a job, but he stayed because the men had stuck with him.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: And, in several ways you were similar in that he, too, did not function as a side man. I mean, but his band too took on sort of the personality of Duke Ellington, you know, and work in that way..
I had the opportunity to be a side man cause Cab offered me a job, you know, when we first got here. I had a few of them, you know. But, I stuck with the band
cause since the fellows were gonna stick with me, I didn't think that I should leave them and go with someone else.

(Inaudible) and go with someone else. So, I figured I'd stay right there and take the chance. See? Because, although the other bands had big names, but they are taking a chance to come out of school and stick with me. So, I stayed with them.
